name: future-assistente-fiscal
description: Build tooling for Future Assistente Fiscal Chrome extension

scripts.build:driver: esbuild src/driver-headless-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=FutureDriverHeadless --outfile=src/driver-headless.bundle.js && license_file=$(find node_modules/driver.js -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*license*' | head -n 1) && test -n "$license_file" && cp "$license_file" docs/DRIVERJS-LICENSE.txt
